cards.example_en: Dinner is the only meal our whole family eats together.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭是我们全家唯一在一起吃的一餐。

cards.example_en: We grilled meat in the yard for my father's birthday.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸过生日时，我们在院子里烤了肉。

cards.example_en: Nothing on the menu looked familiar except rice and eggs.
cards.example_zh: 菜单上除了米饭和鸡蛋，别的都不眼熟。

cards.example_en: Hot milk and bread are my usual breakfast on school days.
cards.example_zh: 热牛奶加面包是我上学日通常的早餐。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：混合物
cards.example_en: Pour the mixture into the tin and bake it for twenty minutes.
cards.example_zh: 把混合物倒进烤盘，烤二十分钟。

cards.example_en: A kind comment can motivate a shy student in class.
cards.example_zh: 一句善意的评语就能激励班上害羞的学生。

cards.example_en: I left my mug on the windowsill and the tea went cold.
cards.example_zh: 我把杯子落在窗台上，茶都凉了。

cards.example_en: Dad's factory uses oil to heat the workshops in winter.
cards.example_zh: 冬天，爸爸的工厂用石油给车间供暖。

cards.example_en: The second passage describes a storm far out at sea.
cards.example_zh: 第二段描写了远海的一场风暴。

cards.example_en: We shared a pizza after the match.
cards.example_zh: 比赛后我们分着吃了一块披萨。

cards.example_en: He dropped his plate and soup spilled on the floor.
cards.example_zh: 他的盘子掉了，汤洒在地板上。

cards.example_en: The plot twisted when the detective guessed wrong.
cards.example_zh: 侦探猜错的时候，剧情发生了转折。

cards.example_en: My uncle in Poland sent a box of chocolates.
cards.example_zh: 我在波兰的叔叔寄来一盒巧克力。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：马铃薯
cards.example_en: She mashed a hot potato with butter for dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭时，她把一个热马铃薯加黄油捣成了泥。
